title: fix: attempt lock release after task failure
body: Move lock release into finally. The lock is now always released, including when acquisition fails, and the original task error is always preserved. Batch jobs use a separate path and need a follow-up.

commits.messageHeadline: fix: attempt lock release after task failure

context.contracts: lock.acquire(), lock.release(), and task() return promises. Each may fulfill or reject. No implementations, production logs, test results, or batch-job source are supplied.
